truth_convention.trueRollDeg: 实测倾角 tilt。图像坐标 y 向下；tilt = atan2(y_imgRightEye - y_imgLeftEye, x_imgRightEye - x_imgLeftEye)；正值 = 图像右侧的眼更低。
truth_convention.expectedCorrectionDeg: app 契约 FaceInfo.rollDeg = -tilt（正=把图像顺时针转）
truth_convention.fixtureDelta: 夹具应有 tilt = 锚点真值 + deltaDeg；生成用 PIL.rotate(-deltaDeg, BICUBIC)
